event_var.var_meaning: Patient vital status at the time of analysis: 'N' appears to indicate deceased (event occurred), 'Y' indicates alive at analysis (censored), '**' appears to denote missing/unavailable

notes: Time and event variables were extracted from the user-supplied supplementary CSV (columns 'OS (days)' and 'Alive at analysis?').

The manuscript (Franses et al., Nature Communications 2020) presents Kaplan–Meier curves for 'overall survival' (Fig. 2c), indicating the endpoint is overall survival; however, the paper does not explicitly define the time origin (e.g., date of diagnosis, date of surgery, or date of blood draw) used for OS in the cohort, so the time-zero for 'OS (days)' is unknown.
Rows with '**' (e.g., locPDAC10) show missing/unavailable values for the event and/or time fields in the provided file.

The mapping 'N' = event (death) and 'Y' = censored (alive at last follow-up) is an inference based on column name and typical usage and is consistent with 'OS (days)' values for 'Y' entries representing follow-up durations; the file/manuscript does not explicitly document this coding.
No other survival endpoints (e.g., PFS, DFS) were identified in the provided supplementary data or clearly defined for this cohort in the manuscript.
